metadata.title: Widget ↔ session wire-up (long-poll streaming + model selector + cost editor)

story.iWant: the chat panel to actually spawn a free-agent session when I send my first message, stream Claude's response live, and let me pick which model to use
story.soThat: the widget is functionally usable as an end-to-end working agent
story.tasks:
API routes: - Add 4 routes to functions/api/index.ts: POST /sessions (create+AssumeRole), POST /sessions/:id/messages (lock+enqueue), GET /sessions/:id (state), GET /sessions/:id/events?after=<seq> (long-poll mirroring party-events). All JWT-gated; owner check via session.operatorId. (AC #1) - Add in-memory sessionCredentialsCache Map at top of api/index.ts. Acceptable v1 cache; cold-start re-AssumeRoles. (AC #1)
Hook + wiring: - Create src/hooks/use-free-agent-session.ts. TanStack Query mutations for createSession + sendMessage. Polling query (1500ms while PROCESSING). Exposes messages, isSending, status, costUsdAccumulated, costCapUsd, sendMessage, setCostCapUsd. (AC #3, #8) - Wire panel.tsx + composer.tsx + message-thread.tsx through the hook.
Model selector + cost editor: - Replace panel-header.tsx model placeholder with real dropdown (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus). Default Sonnet, sticky via localStorage. Mid-conversation change → fork session + emit "Started new conversation with <model>" system message. (AC #4, #5, #6) - Replace cost-burn placeholder with live $X.XX / $Y.YY readout. Amber >80%, red 100%. Inline editor for costCapUsd. Budget-exhausted callout above composer. (AC #7, #8)
Repo extension: - Add setCostCapUsd(sessionId, capUsd) to free-agent-sessions-repository.ts.
Constants: - Add FREE_AGENT_DEFAULT_COST_CAP_USD = 10 to functions/shared/types/free-agent.ts.
Tests: - 3 new API route tests (mirror party-refresh-route.test.ts pattern) — happy path + 400/403/404/409/402 branches. (AC #9) - New hook test (use-free-agent-session.test.tsx). (AC #9) - Extended widget.test.tsx for model selector + cost editor + budget callout. (AC #9) - Extended Playwright smoke for send + model change + cost edit. (AC #10)
Validation: - npm run ci end-to-end. (AC #12)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC #1 — 4 API routes per spec; auth-gated; owner check via session.operatorId. AC #2 — Long-poll (NOT SSE) for v1 per existing party-events pattern. True SSE deferred to v1.1. AC #3 — Composer wired via new use-free-agent-session hook (TanStack Query mutations + polling query). AC #4 — Model selector dropdown: 3 labeled options + tooltip with full model ID. AC #5 — Default Sonnet 4.6; last-used sticky via localStorage 'futurator.free-agent.last-model'. AC #6 — Model change forks the session; "Started new conversation with <model>" system message. AC #7 — Cost cap default $10; inline editor in panel header; setCostCapUsd repo helper. AC #8 — Live cost-burn readout; amber >80%; red 100% + budget-exhausted callout above composer. AC #9 — Unit tests: 3 route tests + hook test + extended widget test. AC #10 — Playwright e2e extended: send + model change + cost edit. AC #11 — Manual EC2 verification (deferred to operator post-deploy). AC #12 — npm run ci passes with no new regressions beyond pre-existing baseline.

story-context.constraints: - Long-poll, NOT true SSE, for v1. Matches existing codebase pattern; avoids awslambda.streamifyResponse complexity. True SSE upgrade is v1.1. [Source: memory feedback_ship_mvp_add_later] - Credentials NEVER returned to browser. Server-side in-memory cache + daemon job payload only. XSS-exfiltration would be a high-severity defect. [Source: Story 18.1 security framing] - In-memory credential cache acceptable for v1 (Lambda warm-start preserves; cold-start re-AssumeRoles). Map<sessionId, SessionCredentials> at top of api/index.ts. [Source: AC #7 + ship-MVP preference] - Model change forks the session (new sessionId, new credentials). claudeSessionId is model-specific and can't be reused. [Source: AC #6] - Cost-cap updates via repository helper, NOT a dedicated PATCH endpoint. Reduces API surface. [Source: AC #7] - Last-used model via localStorage, NOT backend preferences blob. [Source: AC #5 + ship-MVP preference] - All zod validation via .safeParse() only. [Source: CLAUDE.md Validation] - Auth via authMiddleware on every new route; owner check via session.operatorId === c.get('user').userId. [Source: CLAUDE.md Auth + existing party route pattern] - Default cost cap $10. Constant in functions/shared/types/free-agent.ts. [Source: AC #7] - Poll interval 1500ms while status='PROCESSING'; stops on terminal status. Matches existing party-events polling. [Source: AC #3 + party.smoke.spec.ts] - npm run ci must pass with no new regressions beyond pre-existing baseline (4 epic-dev-pipeline failures + Plan.kind/TimerCategory typecheck + agent-daemon.mjs lint warnings + knip warnings). [Source: Story 18.4 CI summary]

interface.name: POST /api/free-agent/sessions (NEW)
POST /api/free-agent/sessions/:id/messages (NEW)
interface.signature: Auth: JWT required. Body: { content: string } Response 202: { jobId, status: 'PROCESSING' } Errors: 400 ValidationError (content >8192 bytes, invalid sessionId) 403 Forbidden (non-owner) 404 NotFound (session missing) 409 SESSION_BUSY (lock held) 402 BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (session at cap)

interface.name: GET /api/free-agent/sessions/:id (NEW)
GET /api/free-agent/sessions/:id/events?after=<seq> (NEW)
interface.signature: Auth: JWT required. Query: after=<eventSeq> (default '000000') Response 200: { events: AgentEvent[], lastSeq: string } Errors: 403, 404

interface.name: setCostCapUsd (NEW repo function)
useFreeAgentSession (NEW hook)

ideas.idea: create-session route — happy path: validates input, calls AssumeRole (mocked), calls createSession, returns sessionId + metadata WITHOUT credentials. Asserts response body has no `accessKeyId`.

send-message route — happy path: validates content, loads session, owner check, acquireProcessingLock, enqueues job with correct payload shape (sessionId, projectId, scope, model, costCapUsd, credentials, messages).
send-message route — 409 SESSION_BUSY when acquireProcessingLock returns { ok: false, reason: 'SESSION_BUSY' }.
send-message route — 400 ValidationError when content > 8192 bytes.
events route — proxies to agentEventsRepo.getEventsAfter(sessionId, afterSeq); returns events + lastSeq.
hook — sendMessage triggers POST /sessions on first call (no session yet), then POST /messages.
hook — polling stops when status transitions to ACTIVE (terminal for the turn).
